findings.title: High Financial Turnover Requirement
findings.fact: The bidder must have an average annual turnover of INR 50 crore in the last 3 years (2015-16, 2016-17, 2017-18) with audited balance sheets and income statements.
findings.business_implication: This is a stringent financial threshold that may exclude smaller but capable event management firms.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that your firm meets the turnover criteria and prepare audited financial statements for the specified years.

quotes.quote: Average annual Turnover of INR 50 Cr in the last 3 years, i.e., 2017-18, 2016-17 and 2015-16 (Audited Balance sheet and Income statements should be submitted for the last three financial years preceding the Bid Submission Date)

findings.title: Minimum Experience in Large Government Events
findings.fact: The bidder must have organized at least 2 international trade/investment promotion events for Central/State Governments in the last 3 financial years, each with expenditure of at least INR 15 crore.
findings.business_implication: This requires a proven track record with large-scale government events, which may be a barrier for firms without such specific experience.
findings.action_recommendation: Gather documentation and proof of past events that meet the criteria, including expenditure details.

quotes.quote: The Bidder should have organized at least 2 (two) international trade/investment promotion events for Central/ State Governments during the last 3 (three) Financial Years (viz., FY 2015-16, FY 2016-17, FY 2017-18). The expenditure incurred for each individual event should be at least INR 15 cr.

findings.title: Mandatory EMD and Bid Processing Fee
findings.fact: Bidders must submit a bid processing fee of Rs. 25,000 and an EMD of Rs. 5 lakh via separate demand drafts payable to PAO, MoFPI, New Delhi, before the bid closing date.
findings.business_implication: These are upfront financial commitments that must be arranged in time; failure to submit will lead to rejection.
findings.action_recommendation: Prepare two demand drafts and ensure they are delivered to the specified address before the deadline.

quotes.quote: Along with the bids, the bid processing fees of Rs.25,000/- and the EMD of Rs.5 lakh must be submitted on or before the bid closing date by way of separate demand drafts payable to PAO, MoFPI at New Delhi to the Director, Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Panchsheel Bhawan, August Kranti Marg, Khelgaon, New Delhi-110049.

findings.title: Bid Submission Deadline and Technical Opening
findings.fact: The last date for bid submission is 07-01-2019 at 5:00 PM, and the technical bid opening is on 08-01-2019 at 11:00 AM.
findings.business_implication: These deadlines are critical; missing them will result in disqualification.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all bid documents are uploaded and EMD/fees are submitted well before the deadline.

findings.title: QCBS with 80:20 Weightage
findings.fact: Selection is based on Quality cum Cost Based Selection (QCBS) with 80% weightage to technical score and 20% to financial score.
findings.business_implication: Technical capability is heavily weighted, so a strong technical proposal is essential for success.
findings.action_recommendation: Focus on preparing a comprehensive technical proposal that addresses all evaluation criteria to maximize technical score.

quotes.quote: Final selection will be made based on Quality cum Cost Based Selection (QCBS system) by giving 80:20 weightage to the technical and financial score respectively.

findings.title: Reimbursement of Costs on Actual Basis
findings.fact: The Ministry shall bear all direct and indirect costs and reimburse the event partner on actual basis for costs incurred in promoting, organizing, and executing the event.
findings.business_implication: This reduces financial risk for the bidder as most expenses are reimbursed, but requires meticulous record-keeping and justification.
findings.action_recommendation: Set up robust cost tracking and documentation processes to ensure accurate reimbursement claims.

quotes.quote: Ministry shall bear all the direct and indirect costs, expenses, fee, charges, taxes etc., and reimburse to event partner on actual basis, the cost and expenses so incurred by event partner (including taxes), including but not limited to promoting, organizing and executing the event, for and on behalf of Ministry for all the activities performed by event partner as covered in the scope of work.

findings.title: Vicarious Liability for Employee Actions
findings.fact: The Applicant shall be vicariously liable for any acts, deeds, or things done by their employees, even if outside the scope of power or instructions issued by MoFPI.
findings.business_implication: This imposes broad liability on the bidder for employee actions, potentially leading to significant financial exposure.
findings.action_recommendation: Review insurance coverage and consider risk mitigation strategies for employee conduct.

quotes.quote: The Applicant shall be vicariously liable for any acts, deeds or things done by their employees which is outside the scope of power vested or instructions issued by MoFPI.

findings.title: Termination Without Cause by MoFPI
findings.fact: MoFPI may terminate the Agreement without assigning any reason by giving 30 days written notice.
findings.business_implication: This gives MoFPI unilateral termination rights, which could disrupt the bidder's operations and investment.
findings.action_recommendation: Assess the risk of termination and plan for potential early termination scenarios.

quotes.quote: MoFPI shall be at liberty to terminate the Agreement without assigning any reason by giving 30 days written notice to the other party.

findings.title: Sponsorship Mobilization Requirement
findings.fact: The event partner must mobilize sponsorships of at least 25% of the total expenditure of the event.
findings.business_implication: This is a significant revenue generation obligation that may be challenging and could impact profitability.
findings.action_recommendation: Develop a detailed sponsorship plan and identify potential sponsors early.

quotes.quote: Mobilising sponsorships of at least 25% of the total expenditure of the event.

findings.title: Financial Bid Submission Format Conflict
findings.fact: Chapter 8 states that financial quotes must be submitted in a separate sealed envelope and uploaded as a PDF document, while Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 indicate that financial bids must be submitted in the prescribed XLS format via the portal.
findings.business_implication: This contradiction could lead to confusion and potential rejection if the wrong format is used.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek clarification from MoFPI on the required format for the financial bid submission.

quotes.quote: The quotes must be submitted in the attached format given in FORM H and uploaded as pdf document.

The Bidders must upload all the required documents electronically in the PDF format except for the Financial Proposal Submission Form (BOQ) which will be electronically uploaded on the prescribed XLS format only on e-Tender portal.
